stem: Members of the House of Lords are elected by the public in a general election.
explanation: Most members of the House of Lords are appointed by the monarch. They are not elected by the public, unlike Members of Parliament.
handbook_ref: Chapter 5 · The development of British democracy

stem: In 1918, women over the age of 30 were given the right to vote.
explanation: The 1918 Act gave women over 30 the right to vote if they met certain property criteria. At the same time, all men over 21 were also given the vote.
handbook_ref: Chapter 5 · The development of British democracy
